prompt:

Every panel is a tall portrait 9:16 still of the same size, separated by thin, even, plain white gutters. All panels are the same moment's world, painted together: the same people, props, weather, light and colour grade in every panel.

Take from image 1: the kind of place: its ground, water, plants, structures and materials. It is ONE view of the place; each panel has its own camera position, so do not repeat this view in every panel; image 2: phone exactly as shown.

People (every panel): every person is a smooth, matte, faceless artist's mannequin in one solid colour, with jointed limbs and simple hands: Anudi is the red mannequin; driver is the blue mannequin. A small raised ridge on the front of the head, where a nose would be, shows which way the head faces. Each mannequin has the person's real height and build and sits, stands and holds things exactly as a real person would. No faces, no hair, no clothes, no skin: only the mannequin colour. Everything else (the place, the props, the light, the weather) is a real, photorealistic film still.

World (every panel): One storyboard image arranged as four equal panels, two across and two down, read left to right, with plain gutters and no drawn text, numbers, symbols or arrows. Render Anudi as a smooth red artist's mannequin and the driver as a smooth blue artist's mannequin, maintaining their supplied relative heights and builds. Paint the surroundings and props realistically: a silver-grey right-hand-drive family car with a dark neutral interior, a structured tan handbag with brass-coloured fittings, a navy folding umbrella, and an orange smartphone with three rear lenses and a transparent case. Soft overcast early-morning daylight has a neutral, restrained grade, with grey asphalt, dusty concrete and muted green surfaces; small shop lamps provide faint amber accents. The ground is already damp, but falling rain appears only in the lower two panels. Phone displays and all surfaces remain free of readable lettering.

Geography: The route follows one narrow Colombo pavement beside patched asphalt and an open kerb drain. The stopping place is first, the modest office frontage lies farther along, and the compact food three-wheeler occupies a vending bay beyond it; Anudi's exterior travel is screen left to right. A weather-stained square utility pole with two dark cable bands, beside a pale-green boundary-wall inset, marks the route ahead and remains on frame right across the sequence. The exterior arrival camera stands on the kerb-edge strip of pavement, streetward of Anudi's walking line, looking obliquely along the car and route; the later cameras stand farther along on the street side, looking across the pavement. The vending bay remains outside the arrival frame, appears only as a small vehicle portion in the next panel, and receives its wider reveal in the last panel.

PANEL 1 (row 1, column 1) — Seated eye height from the front-passenger area, looking obliquely rearward; 32mm medium-wide interior composition, with Anudi at frame left and the driver cropped at the right edge. Background: Softly resolved traffic occupies the left window background. The banded concrete utility pole and a narrow pale-green wall fragment appear through the window area at upper right; roof lining and dark seat backs enclose the composition. The red mannequin sits in the rear-left seat, chest directed toward the front of the car, with its head tilted down toward the smartphone held in its right hand above its lap. Its left hand rests beside the tan handbag on the seat to its left, with the closed navy umbrella lying across the bag. At frame right, the blue mannequin sits in partial profile with its chest and head directed forward toward screen right and both hands resting on the steering wheel.
PANEL 2 (row 1, column 2) — Standing eye height on the pavement's kerb-edge strip, streetward of the walking line, looking obliquely toward the curb-side rear door and along the route; 35mm wide frame. Background: Road and indistinct traffic recede behind the car on frame left. The narrow pavement leads toward the concrete office frontage on frame right, where the banded utility pole and pale-green wall inset are visible; the vending bay is beyond the right crop. The silver-grey car fills the lower left and centre, nose toward screen right, with its curb-side rear door still closed. Through the rear side glass, the red mannequin remains seated with its chest facing the car's front, head lowered toward the phone in its right hand, and left hand beside the handbag and closed umbrella. Through the front glazing, the blue mannequin remains seated with chest and head directed forward and both hands on the wheel. Empty pavement occupies the right side of the frame, with no figure yet standing beside the car.
PANEL 3 (row 2, column 1) — Standing eye height from the street side of the walking axis, looking across the pavement; 40mm medium-wide framing from below the knees, with generous clear space above and toward screen right. Background: The office's weathered concrete frontage occupies the left background. The pale-green wall inset and banded utility pole remain on frame right, alongside only a narrow cropped portion of the food vehicle at the far-right edge; the kerb and open drain run across the lower frame. The red mannequin is centre-left in a side-on walking pose toward screen right, with its chest and head aligned along the pavement rather than toward the camera. Its right hand holds the smartphone near its waist, the handbag hangs from its left forearm, and its left hand grips the still-closed navy umbrella angled downward. Sparse fresh rain streaks cross the open space above it, while the umbrella canopy remains completely folded.
PANEL 4 (row 2, column 2) — Standing eye height from the street side of the same walking axis; 35mm wide frame showing Anudi's full figure, the complete umbrella canopy and the food vehicle. Background: The office frontage recedes at frame left. The muted-green food three-wheeler occupies centre-right with its plain non-working side toward camera; the pale-green boundary-wall inset and banded utility pole remain visible at far right, with pavement extending beyond the vehicle. The red mannequin occupies frame left in full walking profile toward screen right, approaching the near end of the food three-wheeler. Its chest and head point along the pavement, its raised left hand holds the fully open navy umbrella overhead, and the tan handbag remains on its left forearm. Its right hand holds the smartphone near its waist beneath the canopy. Light rain catches the grey daylight around the umbrella, and the vehicle's visible side contains no person or view into its working area.

Bodies (every panel): each person sits or stands the way a real person does the task in front of them, never posed for the camera. The body faces the task and only the head turns: someone at a steering wheel sits squarely behind it, the wheel centred in front of the chest, back against the seat, both hands on the rim; someone at a desk sits square to it; someone at a stove faces the stove. A camera beside a person sees the body side-on, not the chest. Nobody looks into or faces the lens unless the panel says so. Head and eyes turn together: the eyes never roll hard to one side while the face points at the camera; a near-frontal face looks just past the lens.

Draw NO text of any kind: no panel numbers, no captions, no titles, no timestamps, no arrows, no labels, no borders other than the gutters. The people, place and everyday details are Sri Lankan.
